project.summary: Predict and verify post-translational modification (PTM) sites on G-protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs). Given a GPCR (gene name / UniProt accession / protein name), outputs verified PTM sites (from UniProt/iPTMnet/dbPTM) plus predicted candidates, and verifies every cited PMID against its PubMed abstract.
project.prediction_type: RULE-BASED (motif + topology + conservation), NOT machine learning. No training, no parameters, fully reproducible.
interfaces: Flask web UI (auto-opens browser, async progress bar)
project.languages_in_output: Reports/labels are in Chinese (report HTML + console).

pipeline: build membrane topology (N-term/TM/ECL/ICL/C-tail) from UniProt features (KD-window fallback if unannotated)
extract verified sites (L1/L2) with evidence grading + per-PMID PubMed verification
rule-based prediction (L3): consensus motif scan -> topology filter -> cross-species conservation -> scoring
merge + sort (L1 -> L2 -> L3, then score)

modules.main.py: CLI entry; analyze(gpcr_input, refresh, progress, record) -> (results, record, entry, steps); raises AnalysisError instead of sys.exit
modules.webapp.py: Flask app; routes /, /api/submit (POST), /api/status, /api/result; async jobs via threading; in-memory CACHE {accession: html}; auto-opens browser (--no-browser to disable)
modules.output.py: print_report (console, verbose flag), save_json, write_verification_md, build_html(results, record, entry, with_search) -> str, render_html (writes file)
modules.verify_pmids.py: per-PMID verification; fetches PubMed title+abstract (XML primary, text fallback); verdict: 直接/间接(提及位点)/间接(未点名位点)/不支持(位点不符)/不支持(非该蛋白); cache data/pmid_abstract_cache.json; protein_keywords_from_entry()
modules.verified.py: extract_verified(entry, iptmnet_data, topology, progress); three evidence layers; merges records keeping highest layer
modules.predict.py: L3 motifs: PKA [RK][RK]x[ST], PKC [ST]x[RK] (+0.05 if i-1 hydrophobic), CK2 [ST]xx[DE] (acidic at i+2/i+3), CK1 [ST]xx[pS/pT] (priming S/T at i+3), CDK/MAPK [ST]P, proline-directed [ST]P, GRK-candidate (positional hint); N-glyco sequon N-X-S/T (X!=P); palmitoylation juxtamembrane/K-R-rich; NO ubiquitination prediction
modules.conservation.py: Needleman-Wunsch global alignment vs orthologs fetched by exact gene name (mammals mostly); fetch_orthologs(gene) uses reviewed:true
modules.topology.py: build_topology_map(entry); uses UniProt Topological domain descriptions first, then Transmembrane features, gap inference; KD-window fallback if no annotations (labels N-term only unless >=4 TM runs)
modules.scoring.py: score = base * (0.4 + 0.6 * conservation); confidence High/Medium/Low; no circular prior (removed)
modules.resolve.py: resolve_input(text) -> record dict via UniProt search; prefers human + reviewed
modules.ptm_sources.py: iPTMnet API mapping (N-glyco only; C-glyco excluded), dbPTM flat-file parser, iPTMnet-bulk parser
modules.local_db.py: Swiss-Prot flat file parser with /evidence=ECO extraction; acetyl-lysine NOT classified as ubiquitination
modules.download_data.py: optional UniProt human Swiss-Prot flat file (~120MB) via --refresh

layer_system.L2 Supported 有支持: inferred/by-similarity (ECO:0000255/0305/7744), iPTMnet/dbPTM literature or single high-throughput hits (flagged 需实验确认)
layer_system.L3 Predicted 预测: rule-based candidates not in any database

verdicts.直接 (Direct): abstract names this residue + this modification
verdicts.间接 (Indirect): paper about this protein + modification but residue not named
verdicts.不支持 (Unsupported): abstract points to different residue/protein (e.g. Tyr364 paper on a Ser364 site) -> flags database mis-annotation

data_sources.UniProt: REST API: sequence, topology, features, evidence codes
data_sources.iPTMnet: REST API: literature PTM sites with PMIDs
data_sources.PubMed: NCBI eutils efetch, abstracts for verification (XML parse, text fallback, rate-limited 0.35s, cached)

files.{acc}_report.html: interactive collapsible report (site cards, clickable pubmed links, sequence overview)

outputs.example: Query P07550 (ADRB2) produced 7 L1 / 22 L2 / 9 L3 sites; 34 unique PMIDs verified.

usage.web: python webapp.py (browser may need to be opened manually); type a GPCR like ADRB2 / P07550 / OPRM1
usage.cli: python main.py ADRB2 | python main.py P07550 | python main.py OPRM1 --verbose
usage.install: pip install -r requirements.txt (venv is optional, not prescribed; user may use any environment)

handoff_instructions_for_ai.commit_often_push_once: Workflow for pushing: commit frequently (local backup); when the major version is ready, SQUASH the unpushed commits into ONE clean commit so GitHub's history stays tidy, then push. Steps: git log origin/main..HEAD --oneline (count pending) -> git reset --soft origin/main (rewinds branch pointer, keeps all changes staged) -> git commit -m '...' (single squashed commit) -> git push. git reflog recovers the intermediate commits if ever needed.

session_log.context_note: Meaningful context from the original development conversation (2026-08-06 ~ 08-07). The full verbatim transcript is kept locally at ~/gpcr-ptm-transcript.md (NOT in the repo). This section lets a new session resume without re-reading the whole chat.
session_log.origin: User wanted a program that, given a GPCR, outputs verified/verifiable PTM sites AND predicts possible unverified ones, with the logic explained and validated scientifically BEFORE coding. Project dir was originally named gprt_ptm, renamed to gpcr-ptm.
key_decisions: Prediction is RULE-BASED (consensus motif + membrane topology + cross-species conservation), NOT machine learning; scores are ranking-only, never probabilities.

Evidence grading: UniProt experimental (ECO:0000269) = L1 Verified; inferred/by-similarity (ECO:0000255/0305/7744), iPTMnet/dbPTM literature, and single high-throughput hits = L2 Supported (HTP flagged '需实验确认'); rule-based candidates = L3 Predicted.

Fixed evidence-grading inversion found in the original prototype: iPTMnet sites were all marked 'Verified' score 1.0 regardless of evidence quality; UniProt experimental sites could rank lower. Now merged keeping the highest layer, with per-source evidence.
Fixed a circular 'prior' in scoring (same-type PTM sites elsewhere in the protein boosted every candidate) - removed; score = base*(0.4+0.6*conservation).
Topology-aware filtering: N-glycosylation only in extracellular domains; phosphorylation/palmitoylation only in intracellular domains.
Ubiquitination is reported from databases only (no reliable linear consensus for rule prediction).
Per-PMID literature verification against PubMed abstracts; verdicts 直接(Direct)/间接(Indirect)/不支持(Unsupported), with protein-agnostic keywords from the UniProt entry.
Original prototype bugs fixed: PKA regex was wrong (R.R.[ST]); acetyl-lysine was mis-classified as ubiquitination; C-glycosylation was folded into N-glycosylation.

2026-08-07 motif-spacing fixes (predict.py): CK2 acidic check i+1/i+2 -> i+2/i+3; CK1 priming check i+2 -> i+3; PKC +0.05 hydrophobic(i-1) base bonus applied (text-only reason now backed by score). Verified on ADRB2 P07550 against the real sequence: removed false positives (T66 CK1, S236/S396 CK2) and recovered true positives the old off-by-one had missed (S143/T393/T408 CK1, S246/S407 CK2).
verification_findings: ADRB2 (P07550): 7 L1 / 22 L2 / 9 L3; 34 unique PMIDs all verified real and directly relevant to beta-2-AR.
Automated verdicts correctly catch mis-attributions: S364's only cited PMID (8557631) is actually about Tyr364, not Ser364; Y326's PMID 12436935 is a vasopressin-receptor paper.
PMID 28467637 (N-glycosylation paper) names Asn6/15/187 in full text but its PubMed abstract does not - those sites judged 间接 (abstracts-only limitation).
OPRM1 (P35372): correctly shows L1 empty (its UniProt phospho annotations are by-similarity), known C353 palmitoylation and N-term glyco sites in L2.
ui_and_readme_evolution: Console report got a verification column then per-PMID sub-rows (links + verdict + evidence), default compact with --verbose for full detail.
Web UI (Flask): async jobs + progress polling (/api/submit, /api/status, /api/result); auto-opens browser (--no-browser to disable); in-memory result cache; invalid input -> friendly error.
HTML report: gradient header + stat cards, collapsible <details> site cards, color-coded verdict pills, sequence overview always visible (not collapsible per user request).

README final form: English README.md with a badge button to README.zh-CN.md; sections = intro, Usage (minimal), Reading the Output (method integrated, terms shown as 中文(English)), Data Sources, License; removed project tree/cache/Features/layer-table; no separate caveats section.
